origin.description: Draws each equation of a Johansen VAR: the residual series, then its autocorrelation and partial autocorrelation.
origin.details: The residual series is Z0 minus Z1 times GAMMA transpose minus ZK times PI transpose. The autocorrelation and partial autocorrelation are the columns of R0, the concentrated residuals. Each equation is one page: the series across the top, the autocorrelation at the lower left, and the partial autocorrelation at the lower right.
origin.value: A figure for each equation. The compared values are the residual series, the autocorrelations, the partial autocorrelations, and the panel limits.
origin.example:
data(denmark)
sjd <- denmark[, c("LRM", "LRY", "IBO", "IDE")]
sjd.vecm <- ca.jo(sjd, ecdet="const", type="eigen", K=2, spec="longrun", season=4)
plotres(sjd.vecm)
